notes: The list has no Coruscant-set card and the post (25 July 2001) predates Coruscant, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(10)': Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe, Executor: Holotheatre, Visage Of The Emperor, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Epic Duel, Start Your Engines!, Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark), Boonta Eve Podrace, Sebulba's Podracer and Watto's Box; these count toward the 60. A second Visage Of The Emperor is listed under Effects.
Quantities were posted as suffixes ('Emperor Palpatine-2', 'Vaders Obsession-3' etc.) and are read as counts; the section counts (14 characters, 25 interrupts) confirm this.

Posted 'Darth Vader DLOTS-3' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith (the strategy says the deck has 4 Vaders: this plus Darth Vader With Lightsaber); 'Mara Jade TEH-2' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Weapon Lev.-2' the Dark Cloud City Weapon Levitation; 'DR. Evazn/ Ponda Baba' Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba.
Posted 'Defensive Fire/hutt smooch' and 'Ommni Box/It's Worse' dested the combo Interrupts Defensive Fire & Hutt Smooch and Ommni Box & It's Worse.
Fanfare and Secret Plans are 2001-era Effects (not Defensive Shields) in this deck's 60.
Byline posted in lower case as 'jason "waid" wade'.
Posted 'Tatooine Podrace arena' and 'Boonta Eve pod race' dested the Dark pages Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark) and Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark).
